label: T33G IP phone
description: Yealink SIP-T33G entry-level colour-screen desk phone for 4 SIP lines with a dual-port Gigabit Ethernet switch, the second port being a PC passthrough, and integrated 802.3af PoE.
notes: 2.4-inch 320x240 colour display, 4 SIP accounts, local 5-way conference, dual-port Gigabit. PoE class is inconsistently documented: the current Yealink datasheet says IEEE 802.3af class 1, while the same sheet quotes 3.5-5 W PoE draw (class 1 caps the PD at 3.84 W), so this entry budgets class 2 (6.49 W) to stay safe. Wired only, no Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. RJ9 headset/handset and EHS35 not modelled.
